# METADATA 
Freeze 3 survey and clinical modules are imported and merged into a single metadata table for ED–M6 RNA participants. The medication module is excluded from this join because of its long format and is handled as a separate dataset.

## Load and Merge modules 
```{r}
module_files <- c(
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_dissociation_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_support_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_Collision_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_recovery_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_ffmq_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_trauma_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_general_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_hsu_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_su_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_sleep_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_pain_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_somatic_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_gen_health_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_impulsivebehavior_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_depression_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_pss_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_personality_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_ptsd_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_disability_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_anxiety_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_demogr_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_cdrs_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_Injury_mod_2.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_adult_adhd_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_ctq_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_promis_see_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_cs_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_risk_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_polytrauma_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_bfi_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_finimpact_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_mceps_mod.csv",
  "AURORA_Freeze_3_pdi_mod.csv", 
  "AURORA_RDoC_Uni_FS_6m_Frz3_Data_V2.csv")


bad_codes_chr <- c("", "NA", ".", "-5", "-6", "-7", "-8", "-9")
bad_codes_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(bad_codes_chr)) %>% na.omit()

# load study-level sample files
sample_v2 <- readRDS("Data/Metadata/AURORA_Freeze_3/AURORA_sample_data_v2.rds") %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, Site_New, ED_EducationCode, ADI_NatRank, ED1_Event_BroadClass)

sample_v1 <- read_csv("Data/Metadata/AURORA_Freeze_3/AURORA_sample_data_v1.csv",
                      show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, PRE_Pain, LifeTimeEvent_count, ED_NowSomatic_NRS_SUM, M6_Somatic_NRS_SUM,PRE_Pain, WK2_Pain, WK8_Pain, M3_Pain, M6_Pain)

# merge modules for ED–M6 paired RNA PIDs only
metadata_raw <- module_files %>%
  file.path("Data/Metadata/AURORA_Freeze_3", .) %>%
  map(~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE, na = bad_codes_chr)) %>%
  purrr::reduce(full_join, by = "PID") %>%
  left_join(sample_v2, by = "PID") %>%
  left_join(sample_v1, by = "PID") %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

dim(metadata_raw) #2626 (PIDs/participants), 778 metadata columns

# fix the latent class namings to remove "_Class" and rename Avoidance and Hyperarousal 
metadata_raw <- metadata_raw %>%
  rename_with(~ gsub("_Class$", "", .x), ends_with("_Class")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Avoidance = Avoid,
    Hyperarousal = Arousal, 
    Depression = Loss)


metadata_raw %>%
  #filter(PID %in% ED_M6_paired_PIDs) %>%
  mutate(
    ADI_NatRank = replace(ADI_NatRank, ADI_NatRank %in% c(-6, -7, -8), NA),
    ADI_NatRank = as.numeric(ADI_NatRank)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N = sum(!is.na(ADI_NatRank)),
    Mean = mean(ADI_NatRank, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(ADI_NatRank, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min = min(ADI_NatRank, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(ADI_NatRank, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

table(metadata_raw$Site_New)

table(sample_v2$SiteID)
```


## Medication data 
Medication data (not sure if needed) for participants with paired ED–M6 RNA-seq were extracted and reduced to three fields: pre-ED medications, ED medications, and discharge medications. Wide module columns were reshaped into a compact format where each participant has a readable comma-separated list of medications for each timepoint.
```{r}

medication_raw <- read.csv(
  "Data/Metadata/PID Datasets/AURORA_Freeze_3_medication_mod.csv",
  check.names = FALSE) %>%
  filter(PID %in% ED_M6_paired_PIDs) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID,
  matches("^PRE_MED_[0-9]+$"),
  matches("^ED_Meds2_[0-9]+$"),
  matches("^ED_Meds3_[0-9]+$"))

# convert to a easier to read dataframe 
medication_tidy <- medication_raw %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(.x, ""))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -PID,
    names_to  = "var",
    values_to = "drug") %>%
  filter(!is.na(drug)) %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = case_when(
      str_starts(var, "PRE_MED_")   ~ "pre_meds",
      str_starts(var, "ED_Meds2_")  ~ "ed_meds",
      str_starts(var, "ED_Meds3_")  ~ "discharge_meds")) %>%
  group_by(PID, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(meds = list(unique(drug)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = timepoint,
    values_from = meds)

medication_summary <- medication_tidy %>%
  mutate(
    pre_meds = map_chr(pre_meds, ~ paste(.x, collapse = ", ")),
    ed_meds = map_chr(ed_meds, ~ paste(.x, collapse = ", ")),
    discharge_meds  = map_chr(discharge_meds,  ~ paste(.x, collapse = ", "))) %>%
    mutate(
    across(c(pre_meds, ed_meds, discharge_meds),
           ~ na_if(.x, "")))

```

## Cleaning Metadata 
Participant-level metadata were restricted to individuals with paired ED–M6 RNA-seq and complete latent class assignments across ten APNS domains. Demographic, clinical, psychosocial, and medication variables were selected, recoded into interpretable factors (e.g., race, education, marital status, 0/1 meds → No/Yes, combined SNRI/SSRI flags), and key aliases (Age, Site, Trauma_Type, ED_Pain, CTQSF, PDI, ADI) were created for analysis. Low-frequency APNS classes were collapsed (Nightmare, MentalFatigue), and RNA inventory codes and timepoints were merged to yield a harmonized Metadata_Analysis_RNA table for downstream modeling.
```{r}

metadata_filtered <- metadata_raw %>%
  filter(PID %in% ED_M6_paired_PIDs)


metadata_filtered <- metadata_filtered %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(APNS_ordered), ~ !is.na(.x)))

length(metadata_filtered$PID)  # 245  

# numerical variables of interest 
num_vars <- c(
  "ADI_NatRank","ED_Age","BMI","WK2_CTQSF_Total_RS","ED_NowPain","ED_PDI_RS",
  "PRE_Pain","LifeTimeEvent_count","ED_NowSomatic_NRS_SUM","PRE_SF12_PCS",
  "PRE_SF12_MCS","ED_Stress_MAX","M6_Somatic_NRS_SUM","M6_SF12_PCS",
  "M6_SF12_MCS","M6_Stress_MAX","M6_PROM_Pain4a_T","PRE_PROM_AnxBank_RS",
  "PRE_SCRN_GAD_RS","PRE_PROM_Dep8b_T",
  "WK2_PROM_SelfEffEmo4a_T","PRE_PCL5_RS","PRE_PROM_Pain4a_T","PRE_Stress_Max",
  "PRE_PSS10_Total_RS","WK2_FFMQ_RS","M6_FFMQ_RS","WK2_CDRISC10_RS",
  "WK2_BFI_Neuro_RS","PRE_DESB_RS","WK2_DESB_RS","ED_MCEPS_RS", "WK2_PROM_EmoSup4a_RS", "WK2_BFI_Neuro_MN", "WK2_TIPI_Extraversion_MN", "WK2_TIPI_Agreeable_MN", "WK2_TIPI_Conscientious_MN", "WK2_TIPI_EmoStability_MN", "WK2_TIPI_OpenExper_MN")

# categorical variables of interest 
cat_vars <- c(
  "PID","Pain","Depression","Sleep","Nightmare","Avoidance","Reexperience","Anxious",
  "Hyperarousal","MentalFatigue","Somatic","Batch","ED_GenderBirthCert",
  "ED_EducationCode","ED_Marital","ED_RaceEthCode","ED1_Event_BroadClass",
  "Site_New","PRE_PCL5","PRE_PROM_Dep8b","PRE_NSAIDs","ED_NSAIDs","EDhm_NSAIDs",
  "PRE_SNRIs","PRE_SSRIs","ED_SNRIs","ED_SSRIs","EDhm_SNRIs","EDhm_SSRIs",
  "PRE_Opioids","ED_Opioids","EDhm_Opioids","PRE_Contcp","ED_Contcp",
  "PRE_Benzo","ED_Benzo")

keep <- c("PID", num_vars, cat_vars)

metadata_filtered <- metadata_filtered %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(keep)) %>%
  mutate(
    across(any_of(num_vars), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))),
    PID = as.character(PID))


metadata_filtered <- metadata_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    # marital status 
    Marital = case_when(
      ED_Marital == 1 ~ "Married",
      ED_Marital %in% c(2, 3) ~ "Divorced or Separated",
      ED_Marital == 6 ~ "Never Married",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),

    # race 
    Race = case_when(
      ED_RaceEthCode %in% c(1, 4) ~ "Other",
      ED_RaceEthCode == 2 ~ "White",
      ED_RaceEthCode == 3 ~ "Black",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),

    # education 
    Education = ED_EducationCode, 
    
    # gender
    Gender = case_when(
      ED_GenderBirthCert == 1 ~ "Male",
      ED_GenderBirthCert == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
 
   mutate(
    Marital = factor(Marital),
    Race = factor(Race, levels = c("White","Black","Other")),
    Gender = factor(Gender, levels = c("Male","Female"))) %>%
  
  # binary 0/1 -->  No/Yes
  mutate(
    across(
      c(PRE_PCL5, PRE_PROM_Dep8b,
        PRE_NSAIDs, ED_NSAIDs, EDhm_NSAIDs,
        PRE_Opioids, ED_Opioids, EDhm_Opioids,
        PRE_Contcp, ED_Contcp,
        PRE_Benzo, ED_Benzo,
        PRE_SNRIs, PRE_SSRIs,
        ED_SNRIs, ED_SSRIs,
        EDhm_SNRIs, EDhm_SSRIs),
      ~ factor(
          ifelse(. == 1, "Yes", ifelse(. == 0, "No", NA_character_)),
          levels = c("No","Yes")),
      .names = "{.col}"),

    # combined SNRI/SSRI 
    PRE_SNRIs_SSRIs = factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
        PRE_SNRIs == "Yes" | PRE_SSRIs == "Yes" ~ "Yes",
        PRE_SNRIs == "No"  & PRE_SSRIs == "No"  ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("No","Yes")),
    
    ED_SNRIs_SSRIs = factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
        ED_SNRIs == "Yes" | ED_SSRIs == "Yes" ~ "Yes",
        ED_SNRIs == "No"  & ED_SSRIs == "No"  ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("No","Yes")),
    
    EDhm_SNRIs_SSRIs = factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
        EDhm_SNRIs == "Yes" | EDhm_SSRIs == "Yes" ~ "Yes",
        EDhm_SNRIs == "No"  & EDhm_SSRIs == "No"  ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("No","Yes")),

    # aliases
    Site = Site_New,
    Age = ED_Age,
    ED_Pain = ED_NowPain,
    CTQSF = WK2_CTQSF_Total_RS,
    PDI = ED_PDI_RS,
    ADI = ADI_NatRank,
    Trauma_Type = ED1_Event_BroadClass) %>%
  
  # drop old aliases
  dplyr::select(-c(ADI_NatRank, ED_Age, WK2_CTQSF_Total_RS, ED_NowPain,
       ED_PDI_RS, ED_EducationCode, ED_Marital, ED_RaceEthCode,
       ED1_Event_BroadClass, Site_New)) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble()

# order columns 
Metadata_Analysis <- metadata_filtered %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, Age, Gender, Race, BMI, Education, Marital,
    Trauma_Type, Site, ED_Pain, CTQSF, PDI, ADI,
    Pain, Avoidance, Reexperience, Hyperarousal, MentalFatigue,
    Anxious, Somatic, Depression, Nightmare, Sleep,
    dplyr::everything())

# count latent class distributions
class_dist <- Metadata_Analysis %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, all_of(APNS_ordered)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-PID, names_to = "APNS", values_to = "class") %>%
  group_by(APNS, class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(APNS) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  arrange(APNS, desc(n)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = class, values_from = c(n, pct), values_fill = 0)

# merge latent classes together that have < 20 samples in ED - 6M paired comparison 
# nightmare: moderate (47) --> high (15)
# mental fatigue : modrec (14) --> low (86)

Metadata_Analysis <- Metadata_Analysis %>%
    mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  mutate(Nightmare = case_when(Nightmare == "Moderate" ~ "High", TRUE ~ Nightmare),
    MentalFatigue = case_when(MentalFatigue == "Moderate Recovery" ~ "Low", TRUE ~ MentalFatigue))

table(Metadata_Analysis$Nightmare)
table(Metadata_Analysis$MentalFatigue)

#write.csv(Metadata_Analysis, "Data/Metadata/Analysis Data/Metadata_Analysis_8-12-2026.csv")

# add Inventory Code information to metadata 


Metadata_Analysis_RNA_paired <- Metadata_Analysis %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  left_join(RNA_manifest %>% mutate(PID = as.character(PID)),
    by = "PID") %>%
    dplyr::select(PID, INVENTORY.CODE, Timepoint, everything())


#write.csv(Metadata_Analysis, "Data/Metadata/Analysis Data/Metadata_Analysis_All_20260620.csv")

```
